name: TXT2PDF1.JCL
description:
This JCL job converts a text-based card statement file into a PDF document. It executes the TXT2PDF utility to read an input sequential file containing card demo statements and produces a PDF output file, enabling business users to view and distribute statements in a portable document format.Key Functionalities:
Reads the input card statement file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.STATEMNT.PS) in browse mode to convert its text content into PDF format.
Generates a PDF output file named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.STATEMNT.PS.PDF containing the converted statement data.
Utilizes the TXT2PDF rexx/exec utility loaded from dedicated libraries (AWS.M2.LBD.TXT2PDF.LOAD and AWS.M2.LBD.TXT2PDF.EXEC) to perform the text-to-PDF conversion.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The job has been initiated AND all prior job steps have completed successfully with a Return Code equal to 0 (no prior step failures), AND the plain-text Customer Account Statement file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.STATEMNT.PS) is available for read access
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The TXT2PDF conversion utility is invoked with the following parameters: (1) BROWSE mode set to YES — enabling formatted/preview-style rendering for the PDF output, (2) Input source set to the Customer Account Statement plain-text file via the INDD file reference, (3) Output destination set to 'AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.STATEMNT.PS.PDF' as the target PDF file location
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The plain-text Customer Account Statement is fully converted into a formatted PDF document and saved to 'AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.STATEMNT.PS.PDF', AND the original plain-text Customer Account Statement file remains unchanged (read-only access was used), AND if any prior job step had failed (Return Code not equal to 0), this conversion step is skipped entirely and no PDF is generated

rules.Rule_Name: TXT2PDF - TXT2PDF REXX - Customer Account Statement Text-to-PDF Conversion
rules.Rule_Description: This step invokes the TXT2PDF external REXX utility to convert the Customer Account Statement from plain text format into a formatted PDF document. The step is conditionally executed based on the success of all prior job steps, and the conversion is performed with formatted/preview rendering enabled to ensure the PDF output is properly structured.
